sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the skill, see Immunity.

Immunity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Well, you've proven you won't shoot indiscriminately. Recently, one of my men was poisoned on a mission and didn't even make it to the extraction point. We couldn't figure out what toxin caused his death. The guy went on a scouting trip to the white chalk circles. I need a more fresh sample and a tough employee who can survive the poisoning and make it back from the raid."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Extract from the location with the "Unknown toxin" status effect

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Fence Rep +0.02
- 1,150 Euros
  - 1,208 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,323 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 5× XTG-12 antidote injector
"You survived the poisoning? Now I'll try to get some information from your blood samples and get in touch with the right people. Either way, you've already earned your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to extract from a raid while suffering from the effect.

The effect is inflicted by being stabbed with a Cultist knife, by either a Cultist or another player. Barbed wire in The Labyrinth also has a chance to inflict the effect upon contact.

While being afflicted with the status effect, your health points will drain at a rate of 140/min. You can use a Propital injector to partially counteract the health drain for 5 minutes, or an ETG injector to fully nullify the damage for 60 seconds. It is highly recommended to bring multiple medkits.
